{{RV|type=command

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= RTD

|descr= Toggle the starter for the given helicopter engine(s) on or off. 
* engine index 0: engine #1
* engine index 1: engine #2
* engine index 2: engine #3
* engine index -1: all engines

|s1= helicopterRTD [[setStarterRTD]] [enable, engineIndex]

|p1= helicopterRTD : [[Object|ObjectRTD]] - helicopter

|p2= enable : [[Boolean]] - on or off

|p3= engineIndex : [[Number]] - engine index

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>vehicle player setStarterRTD [true, -1];</sqf>

|seealso=
}}
